name: Voice
description: Talk to the desk and hear it read aloud. Works in Edge and Chrome with no install; uses whisper.cpp and Piper on this PC when you point it at them, or ElevenLabs with your key.
attribution: whisper.cpp (MIT) https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp: optional local speech to text, run as a separate program
Piper (MIT, archived; successor piper1-gpl is GPL-3.0) https://github.com/rhasspy/piper: optional local text to speech, run as a separate program
ElevenLabs API (hosted, the owner's own key) https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference: optional text to speech and speech to text
